description.value: Lakeside Campground is a developed BC Parks site within Sasquatch Provincial Park, set among pocket lakes, birch forest, and mountain ridges six kilometres north of Harrison Hot Springs. Sandy-beach swimming, canoeing, and short hiking trails make it a well-rounded stop; swimmer's itch is possible in the lakes during summer.
